title: In vitro assay to quantify satellite cell activation using isolated mouse myofibers
author: Canibano-Fraile, Boertjes, et al.

steps.title: Fix myofibers with PFA
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm 8 % paraformaldehyde (v/v) to 37 °C, place the 96‑well dish containing cultured fibers on a slide warmer, add 100 µL of the pre‑warmed 8 % PFA to each well and incubate 15 min inside a chemical safety cabinet, then aspirate the fixative, rinse thoroughly with PBS and replace with PBS; fixed fibers may be stored at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks or processed immediately.

steps.title: Permeabilize fibers
steps.instruction: Incubate fibers with 0.5 % Triton X‑100 in PBA (v/v) for 30 min at 18–22 °C.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Block with 20 % horse serum (HS, v/v) for 30 min at 18–22 °C.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation (PAX7)
steps.instruction: Incubate with anti‑PAX7 primary antibody diluted 1:100 in PBA‑Tw for 1 h at 18–22 °C (optional: extend to 12–16 h at 4 °C in a humidified chamber).

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation (KI67 or MYOD)
steps.instruction: For KI67 co‑staining: incubate with anti‑KI67 (1:100 in PBA‑Tw) together with biotinylated anti‑mouse IgG (1:250 in PBA‑Tw) for 1 h at 18–22 °C. For PAX7‑MYOD co‑staining: incubate with anti‑MYOD (1:500 in PBA‑Tw) plus Biotin Anti‑Mouse IgG1 (1:250 in PBA‑Tw) for 1 h at 18–22 °C.

steps.title: Secondary detection reagent incubation
steps.instruction: For PAX7‑KI67: incubate with Streptavidin‑AF647 (1:500 in PBA‑Tw) and goat anti‑rabbit AF488 (1:500 in PBA‑Tw) for 1 h at 18–22 °C. For PAX7‑MYOD: incubate with Streptavidin‑AF647 (1:500 in PBA‑Tw) and goat anti‑mouse IgG2B‑Cy3 (1:500 in PBA‑Tw) for 1 h at 18–22 °C.

steps.title: Nuclear staining with Hoechst
steps.instruction: Incubate with Hoechst 33342 at 1 µg/mL in PBS for 15 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Final rinse and keep moist
steps.instruction: Rinse once with PBS‑Tw and add 100 µL PBS to each well to keep cells moist.

steps.title: Image immunostained fibers
steps.instruction: Acquire images of the immunostained fibers as soon as possible, but no later than one week after staining; use a 10× objective (e.g., Nikon Eclipse Ti) and capture 5–6 sequential images per myofiber to cover its length, imaging at least five intact myofibers per condition.

steps.title: Quantify satellite cell activation
steps.instruction: Count Hoechst‑positive nuclei to identify all cells, record colonies containing PAX7⁺/KI67⁺ (or PAX7⁺/MYOD⁺) cells, exclude wells with short fragments, contracted or damaged fibers, and exclude cells located >200 µm from the fiber; express colony size as number of myofiber‑derived cells per fiber. Manual counting or image‑analysis software (e.g., FIJI, Photoshop) may be used.
